title: mobiusmatch
blurb: a viral personality quiz for the mino.mobi cinematic universe. seven questions, no wrong answers, and you get matched to one of ~42 curated mino.mobi sites (pulled live from mino.mobi's own deploy registry) across 7 vibe categories, from generators to the O'Neill cylinder. @norvid-studies.bsky.social pitched "which mobius website is best for you" and bisks.net asked the bot to give it a go.
